Welcome to the Sisco Mailing list. The purpose of this mailing list is to get researchers of the FRANCISCO/SISCO/CISCO and related families sharing thoughts and research. My Intention is to find out all I can about our family and to share it with others.
There are a few simple rules.
1. No spam!
2. No graphic attachments
3. Be polite!
4. Have a good time!
Important!

Before subscribing make sure your internet service provider or email provider will accept multiple mailings and large files. Some email providers will throw out mail list becasue they treat them as SPAM. Also, some email providers limit the size of the file and some files sent from our users can get pretty big.
If you do this I will be eternally grateful. This will save me from the vile daemon of undeliverable mail.
Your host
Tom Sisco

You can subscribe to the list in mail mode by sending a message

subscribe

and then subscribe to the other.
